_readme: Svr2Desktop v11.0 configuration. This file is OPTIONAL - delete it and the script falls back to its built-in defaults. Only the keys listed below are read; every other key is ignored on purpose, so a stray or tampered file cannot redirect backups, logs, temp paths or switch on dangerous behaviour.
_readme_downgrade: The Downgrade stage (UAC prompts / Defender / password expiry / Security Center alerts) has NO configuration key here, by design. A security downgrade must be chosen explicitly - menu [10], -Stage Downgrade, or -Stage All - and never toggled on by a file sitting next to the script.
_readme_neverdisable: NeverDisable is a hard guard list: any service named here can never be disabled by the Services stage, even if the script logic is changed later. Spooler and WlanSvc sit here because printing/PDF export and wireless are usually wanted.
